method: Bounded project transcriptions/reports from primary scans visually read. Greek papyrus texts and their damage marks are ancient source evidence mediated by editions; no new photograph or correcting-hand authentication. Latin version traditions are not independent Greek manuscript votes. Bonner commentary consulted for bounded facts, not reproduced as a modern prose source.

transcriptions.10: ο γαρ συν / [ιω]ν τουτ[ο] δυνησεται δια / [κ]ονησαι τ[ι α]γαθον

excerpts.qualification: Line breaks marked slash. Initial psi in souls is supplied; preserved uchas alone cannot decide epsilon-vs-psi. Final singular understanding/service clause is normalized with supplied letters retained: ὁ γὰρ συν[ίω]ν τοῦτ[ο] δυνήσεται δια[κ]ονῆσαί τ[ι ἀ]γαθόν. Accents/punctuation are editorial. Not all letters are ink. Three early Greek witnesses support construction with differences; Latin versions provide separate comparison.
